victim.augmentation: reflect-pad-4 per-image random crop plus random horizontal flip

attack.reference: Qi et al., Revisiting the assumption of latent separability for backdoor defenses, ICLR 2023
attack.fidelity_boundary: trigger split into 16 equal 8x8 pieces of the frozen Hello-Kitty asset, half of the pieces active per training row, train alpha 0.15, full trigger at test alpha 0.2, conservatism (cover) rows that carry the partial trigger but keep their true label; payload and cover counts are set to the block-12 poison budget instead of the original low rates
attack.payload_selection: development.poison_plan: non-target rows of the fixed 45000-row split, seed 4242100 + victim_seed
attack.cover_selection: non-target, non-payload rows, numpy default_rng(4243100 + victim_seed).choice without replacement
attack.resize: torchvision Resize((32,32)) with bilinear interpolation and antialiasing
attack.transform: x + alpha * m * (trigger - x), clipped to [0,1], applied after training augmentation; m is the per-row piece mask in training and all ones at test
attack.poison_definition_for_the_policy: payload rows only (attacker-relabelled rows); cover rows are correctly labelled and count as clean records of their class
